units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:7">B. Mets. VI, 7</cite> <he>הלוהו על המ׳</he> if one loaned on a pledge.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:7">Ib.</cite> <he>מותר … מַשְׁכּוֹנוֹ וכ׳</he> man is permitted to hire out the poor man’s pledge (for the debtor’s benefit). Ib. 82ᵃ (in Chald. dict.) <he>בדלא שוי מ׳ וכ׳</he> when the pawn is not worth the money loaned on it. Ib. <he>בעל חוב קונה מ׳</he> the creditor owns the pledge (for the time being, and is reponsible for it); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:10">Ex. R. s. 31</cite> <he>אל תהא קורא מִשְׁכָּנִי אלא מַשְׁכּוֹנִי</he> read not (<cite ref="Leviticus 26:11">Lev. XXVI, 11</cite>) ‘my dwelling’ but ‘my pledge’.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35:4">Ex. R. s. 35</cite> (play on <he>למשכן</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 26:15">Ex. XXVI, 15</cite>) <he>שהוא עומד למַשְׁכָּן וכ׳</he> the sanctuary stands as a pledge, when the Israelites deserve destruction, it is seized on their account.—Pl. <he>משְׁכּוֹנוֹת</he>, <he>מַשְׁכָּנוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Exodus 26:15">Ib.</cite> s. 31 (ref. to <he>משכנתיך</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 24:5">Num. XXIV, 5</cite>) <he>שני מ׳</he> two pledges (the First and the Second Temple); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:14">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <he>אל תהי קורא מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ אלא מַשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ</he> read not thy dwellings &c. (v. supra); Tanḥ. Naso 14. Ex. R. l. c. (with ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 22:25">Ex. XXII, 25</cite>), cmp. <cite ref="H00026"><he>חֲבוֹלָה</he></cite>; a. fr.
